recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, close-up portrait of a woman with a 1960s beehive hairstyle and sequined attire, featuring right-aligned, decorative swash typography against a desaturated, off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head tilt mirroring the angle of the top text line
Contrast between dark hair and the high-key, washed-out background
Textual weight balanced by the visual mass of the subject's head and shoulder
Texture of the sequins echoing the curves of the swash lettering
coreInvariants: Subject looking down and away from the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left and bottom-center, scaled to a medium-close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, voluminous hair at the top left serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dark hair, moves down the face to the sequins, then sweeps up to the right-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the right side, utilized for typographic placement.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown/Black for hair and primary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), creating a faded, vintage feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to desaturated pastels and deep earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Curled terminals and extended swashes on capital letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking swashes between adjacent capital letters

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space opposite the subject's face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two contrasting colors (Black and Lavender).
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines for metadata at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s-era heavy weight and decorative curls.
Provides the bulbous, fluid curves seen in the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with a 1960s beehive hairstyle, wearing a white sequined top. The lighting should be soft and bright, with the subject positioned on the left looking down. The background should be a textured off-white paper style with plenty of empty space on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the top right quadrant using a heavy, decorative swash script. Use black for the top line and a muted lavender for the subsequent lines. Ensure tight line spacing.

verificationChecks: Does the font feature heavy swashes?
Is the lighting high-key and desaturated?
Is the subject's hair a prominent dark mass?

mustAchieve: Balanced asymmetry between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the background has a subtle paper grain texture.
Ensure the lavender color is muted and not neon.
Confirm the swashes on the letters are prominent and fluid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key vintage portrait with right-aligned, heavy swash typography in a two-color palette to evoke mid-century soul music aesthetics.
